idea-plugin.name: Kiln Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A warm dark and light theme: charcoal and cream surfaces, a clay orange accent, and calm, earthy syntax colors.

  • Kiln Dark: warm charcoal editor with a darker frame.
  • Kiln Light: cream editor with a soft sand frame.

Built on the Islands themes, so tool windows, tabs, and popups all follow the palette. Each variant ships with a matching editor color scheme and terminal colors.

Choose it in Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance | Theme.
